eps.ov: Seido and Inashiro prepare for the game that will take one of them to Koshien.
The finals kick off as first innings from Narumiya and Furuya set the tone.
The shutout continues as each team looks for a flaw in their opponent's dominant pitching.
Inashiro's lineup seeks to take advantage of Furuya's early signs of weakness.
The top of Seido's lineup looks to strike back against Inashiro.

eps.t: The Team I Want to Be On
eps.ov: Narumiya tries to navigate out of a jam with the heart of Seido's order coming to the plate.
